summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Pampa Energía S.A., an Argentine electric utility, reporting a board resolution approving a final investment decision (FID) for the development of a large fertilizer production complex (urea and ammonia) via its wholly-owned subsidiary Fértil Pampa. The project requires ~US$2.7 billion in investment and involves an EPC contract with Tecnimont SPA and SACDE S.A. The board also approved granting parent guarantees to secure the subsidiary's payment obligations. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, spin-off, or other special-situation transaction is described. The filing is a routine capital project update, not an event-driven corporate action.
